values.value: Active product missing rev rec rule
SELECT Id, Name FROM Product2 WHERE IsActive = true AND blng__RevenueRecognitionRule__c = null
Active product "{Name}" has no revenue recognition rule
Active product has no revenue recognition rule assigned. Revenue for this product will not be recognized.

Finds: Active Product2 records with blng__RevenueRecognitionRule__c null. Why it matters: Without a rev rec rule, revenue can't recognize on the proper schedule — it either recognizes immediately (wrong for subscription products) or never (wrong for one-time fees). ASC 606 / IFRS 15 compliance breaks on every affected sale. Suppress a finding: for products intentionally outside rev rec (free, internal). Disable the detector: only when rev rec is intentionally manual. Most should leave this on.
